query:
WITH candidates AS (
            SELECT sequence
            FROM chat_message_events
            WHERE created_at < NOW() - ($1::bigint::text || ' seconds')::interval
            ORDER BY created_at ASC, sequence ASC
            LIMIT $2
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
        DELETE FROM chat_message_events e
        USING candidates c
        WHERE e.sequence = c.sequence
